title: Accessible typography and inline semantics
description: Use Strong, Emphasis, Small and VisuallyHidden for semantic emphasis, accessible button labels and keyboard-visible skip links.

intro: Choose native emphasis semantics and keep visual presentation separate from accessible names. VisuallyHidden keeps content available to screen readers and can reveal a contained skip link on focus.
useCases: Icon-only controls with meaningful accessible names.
Skip links that reveal themselves during keyboard focus.

faqs.question: Do these additions change existing defaults?
faqs.answer: No. Existing heading levels, text sizes and boolean formatting remain available. New explicit variants take precedence when supplied.

sections.heading: Composition and API
sections.body: Import all primitives from @zentauri-ui/zentauri-components/ui/typography. Semantic inline elements inherit their surrounding tone unless an explicit tone is supplied.

sections.heading: Accessibility
sections.body: Keep heading levels aligned with the document outline. VisuallyHidden is not aria-hidden and does not make a wrapper focusable automatically. Supply a real link and a target for skip navigation.
